sourcePreservation.scope: Every original archived column/row and sequence; added columns verified separately without invented historical evidence.

pauseAdmissionRace.scope: Offline synthetic tenant; actual operator request and admission functions.

coverage: All seven production packages install in order with exact original table, view, helper authority and data preservation.
Wrong target, table drift, late failure rollback and duplicate migration rejected.
Existing effective-dated OpenFolk grant permits control; ordinary tenant owner, anonymous role and View-As do not.
Control receipts replay exactly, reject stale edits, retain cancellation tombstones and roll back flags when receipt storage fails.
Malformed flags block admission without leaking raw values. Master disable governs Email, Phone and Slack.
Paused email and Slack queue work retains its attempt allowance; retained Slack pages remain eligible for settlement.
Claimed work defers without burning a retry; foreign-tenant deferral and deferral of an already saved page are rejected.
Real phone pipeline view selects retained-audio processing ahead of paused downloads.
Two-session actual operator request holds the control lock; waiting admission observes the committed pause instead of its earlier state.
fixtureAdaptations: Actual auth.users profile creation, existing operator permission registry and production View-As shape replace stub fixtures.
Only synthetic queued jobs receive highest priority (lower numeric value) and a one-job claim; no source jobs are pre-cleared.
Synthetic phone_recordings feed the actual pipeline view instead of inserting into a stub table.
First terminal rehearsal preserved the archive but exposed reversed fixture priority; v2 corrects that ordering and adds concurrency. Candidate SQL is unchanged.
limitations: No production/hosted TEST changes, real grants, provider requests or signed-in checks.
This is database-side control acceptance; matching worker deployment and real provider-boundary acceptance remain required.
Commusoft controls and later voicemail/Microsoft extensions remain part of the unfinished full release.
An already admitted bounded provider batch may finish after a pause; subsequent admission must stop. Retained source records are never deleted by a pause.
Archive preservation excludes known pg_net omissions; full runtime/Vault recovery remains unproven.
